title: Dashboard
subtitle: Overview of your Claude Code configuration

claudeMdSection.title: CLAUDE.md Configuration Files
claudeMdSection.description: Overview of all discovered CLAUDE.md files across your projects

thinking-budget-unset.title: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS is unset
thinking-budget-unset.detail: Thinking runs without a budget. Setting it caps the most variable part of your output cost.

subagent-model-unset.title: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL is unset
subagent-model-unset.detail: Subagents inherit your main model. Pointing them at a cheaper model cuts the cost of wide fan-outs.

autocompact-off.title: Auto-compact is disabled
autocompact-off.detail: Once context fills up, every turn resends the full history. Leaving it on keeps long sessions affordable.

mcp-heavy.title: {{count}} MCP servers configured
mcp-heavy.detail: Every server's tool descriptions sit in context on each request. Past ~{{limit}}, disable the ones you rarely use.

surface-heavy.title: {{count}} skills, commands, agents and MCP servers
surface-heavy.detail: A large tool surface makes the model's choices fuzzier. Past ~{{limit}}, prune what you no longer use.

opus-pinned.title: Default model pinned to {{model}}
opus-pinned.detail: Most edit-and-search work does not need Opus. Switching the default to Sonnet cuts token cost several-fold.

stop-hook-no-guard.title: {{count}} Stop hook(s) without a stop_hook_active guard
stop-hook-no-guard.detail: Claude Code passes stop_hook_active to Stop and SubagentStop hooks. A handler that ignores it keeps blocking the turn from ending, which surfaces as "A hook blocked the turn from ending N consecutive times". Affected: {{names}}

hook-script-missing.title: {{count}} hook(s) point at a script that does not exist
hook-script-missing.detail: The referenced file is missing, so the hook fails silently and never runs. Affected: {{names}}

claude-md-bloat.title: CLAUDE.md totals {{chars}} characters (~{{tokens}} tokens)
claude-md-bloat.detail: CLAUDE.md is re-sent on every turn, so its size is paid for continuously. Splitting rarely-needed detail into referenced files keeps the always-on part small.

permissions-wide-open.title: {{count}} allow rule(s) open a whole tool
permissions-wide-open.detail: A rule matching an entire tool removes the confirmation step for every call of that tool, including ones the rule was never meant to cover. Rules: {{rules}}

dangerous-skip-enabled.title: Dangerous-mode confirmation is turned off
dangerous-skip-enabled.detail: skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt is true, so entering permission-bypass mode no longer asks for confirmation. Intentional for some setups; listed here so it stays a deliberate choice.
